full_details: Both locks were off before light. You kept nine shillings out for the journey and counted the rest at thirty-three pounds. You did not add the nine back, and you did not write a second total. At Old Swan the hoops were rimmed with frost, the trunks covered, and my lord's scarlet coats folded on a basket. The paper went in first and driest, the rolls in oiled cloth. Garnish sat the chest. Six oars, and Gannet at the stern, on the first of the flood. He cast off with Windsor, ice at Kew, and a peace. You did not correct him. In the afternoon the Feathers had you. The paper has the dry room. The baskets are where a man need not climb. The boys are under Phillips. You are three to a bed, with Heminges and Bryan. At the window you said a year ago was Greenwich, and the cloak is the same cloak.
one_sentence: Before light you counted thirty-three pounds and kept nine shillings out, then went up on the flood and took a bed with two others.
title: Nine shillings out, and a bed of three
